location_name: Drop zones west of Utah Beach (Saint-Come-du-Mont / Sainte-Marie-du-Mont area)
composing_units: 501st Parachute Infantry Regiment; 502nd Parachute Infantry Regiment; 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment; 327th Glider Infantry Regiment
current_activity: parachuting behind Utah Beach to seize causeways and bridges
engaged_with: German 91st Luftlande Division; German 709th Static Infantry Division
notes: Dropped from ~01:30 behind Utah to control causeways and Douve bridges; widely scattered drops.
Forced the causeway into Carentan 10-11 June; 327th GIR crossed the Douve early on 10 June.
Carentan captured 12 June after German withdrawal for lack of ammunition; Hill 30 taken by 05:00.
Counter-attack by 17th SS PzG Division at dawn 13 June (Bloody Gulch, Manoir de Donville) repulsed with help of CCA 2nd Armored.

current_activity: assigned to VIII Corps in a defensive role
notes: Division assigned to newly arrived US VIII Corps 15 June in a defensive role.
